title: Volcanoes of Iceland (guided)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Iceland, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders to help you.

rounds.name: Eyjafjallajokull
rounds.fact: Eyjafjallajokull is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 2010. The data places it in Iceland.
